title: Relic System — Joker-equivalent passive run modifiers
description: Implement 10 RELICS (persistent passive modifiers active for the full run). Player picks 1 relic from 3 random choices at run start (new 'relicpick' state). At pit stops, 1 in 3 choices is a relic instead of a card. Max 3 relic slots (expandable via FC-004 Trait Forge). Show relic slots as icons below the score HUD. Relic effects applied in tickPlaying() and via modified physics constants. RELICS: coin_press (+2 bits/pipe), lucky_wing (25% triple bits), iron_feather (gravity-20%/gap-10%), hot_rod (speed+15%/bits+50%), ghost_mantle (free ghost at each pit), turbo_heart (flap+25%), bit_magnet (combo threshold-2), death_wish (1 life/bits×4), shield_cloak (auto-shield on respawn), echo_lens (duplicate last card effect).
